status: iteration-1 design, awaiting sign-off on the primary assertions
notes: Iteration 1 measures a variance defect: decision_details, rationale and conditions sometimes carry the same content — roughly half of runs, by report.

A single run cannot tell a fix from luck on a defect that intermittent, so the same eval is repeated and what gets compared is the RATE, not one output. At a true rate of 50%, the chance of 8 clean runs is 0.4%.
Iteration 1 is the BASELINE: current skill, nothing changed. The rule fix comes after, and iteration 2 compares rates.

Contamination does not affect this measurement. The fixture's answers are worked through in references/extraction.md, which makes it useless for judging whether a decision was caught correctly — but duplication is a mechanical property of the output, and knowing the right answer does not stop a run writing the same sentence into two fields.
Scope: one thread. The rate is a rate on THIS thread.

evals.name: field-separation-on-reference-thread
evals.prompt: Run the skill end to end on the reference thread and produce the Present-stage output: the opening line, the Read Me, every Decision card with its nested Actions, and Review Notes.
evals.expected_output: Two Decision cards and two Actions. decision_details, rationale and conditions each carry content the other two do not.

assertions.text: No sentence in decision_details answers WHY the decision was made. Details carries what was decided, its scope and its mechanism; the case for it belongs in rationale.
assertions.why: This is the direction the rules never stated. decision_details excludes conditions, refs, proposer and the title — but says nothing about rationale, and rationale says nothing back.

assertions.text: No sentence in rationale describes WHAT was decided. Rationale carries the reasons the thread gave; the decision itself belongs in decision_details.
assertions.why: The other half of the same missing rule.

assertions.text: No content in conditions also appears in decision_details, in any wording.
assertions.why: This exclusion IS stated, in one direction. Checking it separates a rule that is written but not landing from one that was never written.

assertions.text: No sentence-level near-duplicate between decision_details, rationale and conditions, by n-gram overlap above threshold.
assertions.why: Deterministic tripwire for literal restatement. Catches less than the grader items but never disagrees with itself.

assertions.text: D1.pst and D2.pst are both 'Pax Pricing'.
assertions.why: Regression. Free, since the runs are happening anyway.

assertions.text: Exactly two Actions across both Decisions.
Every rendered Slack permalink ends in p followed by digits only — no dot.
The string 'Mexico' does not appear anywhere in the output.
The string 'FF Ecommerce' does not appear as a pst value.
Review Notes contains a 'Not Identified as Decisions' category with six entries.
